name: Shri Techtex Ltd.
summary: Shri Techtex Ltd. is a manufacturer in the technical textiles industry, specializing in the production of Polypropylene (PP) Spunbond Non-Woven Fabrics. The company manufactures these fabrics in various sizes and densities, catering to a range of industrial applications. Its products are utilized in sectors such as hygiene, medical, agriculture, home furnishing, and packaging. Shri Techtex also produces Non-Woven Geotextile and Non-Woven Synthetic Roofing Underlayment. The company operates a manufacturing-led business model, converting Polypropylene granules into non-woven fabric at its facility in Simaj, Gujarat, and offers customized solutions to its clients.
